A complete no-op iteration (no file changes AND no new meaningful learnings worth recording) is not a success - set success=false so the run can halt rather than spin on no-op iterations

- key_changes_made: an array of descriptions for key changes you made. don't group this by file - group by logical units of work. don't describe activities - describe material outcomes

If needed, a short tutorial with popover over the UI can be launched at the start (of course only when user first visit the site. Also configure the CI/CD to automatically deploy the site on gcloud. content.text: I'll audit the live UI for leftover novice-facing jargon or layout issues that could still move the needle.

input.command:
HTML=$(curl -sL "https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/")
# Spot-check residual jargon / objective keywords in live HTML
for term in 'Load Trace' 'algorithms' 'Smaller keeps more detail' 'Fréchet' 'Douglas' 'original.txt' 'Baseline' 'Dead candidates' 'Candidate region' 'Paths \& search' 'simplified path' 'Match tolerance' 'path step' 'Compression' 'Fit to data' 'Anchor points' 'Current search region' 'Still-allowed' 'Next landing'; do
  count=$(printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -c "$term" || true)
  echo "$count	$term"
done
echo '---'
# Check for remaining potentially opaque user-visible strings
printf '%s' "$HTML" | rg -o 'title="[^"]{20,}"' | head -40
echo '---aria---'
printf '%s' "$HTML" | rg -o 'aria-label="[^"]+"' | head -30
echo '---labels---'
printf '%s' "$HTML" | rg -o '<(button|label|summary|span|h[1-3]|option)[^>]*>[^<]{2,40}<' | head -50
# Check open PR / branch sync
gh pr list --head gnhf/fix-any-usability-pr-5460d8 --state all --limit 5 2>/dev/null; git log origin/main..HEAD --oneline | wc -l; git rev-parse HEAD origin/main
input.description: Audit live HTML jargon and branch state

input.command:
# Context for remaining Fréchet and any user-visible Baseline strings
curl -sL "https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/" | rg -n -i 'Fréchet|Frechet|Baseline' | head -40
# Confirm main vs live vs local docs commit
git fetch origin main 2>&1 | tail -5
git log --oneline origin/main -3
git log --oneline HEAD -3
# Diff USABILITY Still open vs what's on main
git show origin/main:web/USABILITY.md | rg -A 20 '^## Still open'
echo '---local---'
rg -A 20 '^## Still open' web/USABILITY.md
# Disk space note
df -h /System/Volumes/Data | tail -1
# Confirm Deploy workflow present on main
gh api repos/yeungsinchun/Simplification-of-Trajectory-Streams/actions/workflows --jq '.workflows[] | "\(.name) \(.state) \(.path)"' 2>/dev/null
gh run list --workflow=deploy.yml --limit 3 2>/dev/null || gh run list --limit 5 2>/dev/null
input.description: Check Fréchet, main sync, Deploy status

curl -sL "https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/" | rg -n 'Fr[ée]chet|frechet' -i | rg -v 'params-metric--frechet|compare-frechet|min-width|align-items'
# Also check viewer.js on live
curl -sL "https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/viewer.js" | rg -n 'Fr[ée]chet|frechet' -i | head -20
# Any remaining user-facing jargon worth fixing?
curl -sL "https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/viewer.js" | rg -n 'alert\(|confirm\(|innerHTML|textContent\s*=' | head -5
# Quick scan for opaque remaining visible strings in viewer
curl -sL "https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/" | rg -o '>[^<]*(?:ε|δ|PED|LSSD|S_i|B_p|Fréchet|algorithm|simplif|trace|vertex|reachab)[^<]*<' -i | head -30
curl -sL "https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/viewer.js" | rg -o "'[^']*(?:algorithm|simplif|trace|Fréchet|Load Trace|path step|Dead |Anchor|Candidate region)[^']*'" -i | head -40
